author: reek
body: Minimal HTTP/1.0 response formatting. Builds response bytes (status line, headers, body) suitable for sending over TCP. Request parsing is intentionally minimal -- just enough to detect GET and extract the path.

author: val
body: The body is everything after the CRLF CRLF blank line that ends the header block, empty when the request has no body or no blank line. Bare-LF requests are not recognized; senders must use CRLF per the HTTP specification.
